description: This file defines an exception class 'UnrecognizedProtocolVersionException' used within the Laminas Diactoros package to handle specific error conditions related to unrecognized protocol versions.

classes.name: UnrecognizedProtocolVersionException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating an unrecognized protocol version error, extending the built-in UnexpectedValueException.

methods.name: forVersion
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of UnrecognizedProtocolVersionException with a formatted message indicating the problematic protocol version.
